Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date (EDGAR's acceptance time; after the 16:00 ET close, the next trading day; before 2002 the filing date). Per-share figures are on the share basis of their filing ('share_basis' where it predates the filing); the builder restates them for the splits effective by AS_OF.

splits.note: The additional shares resulting from the stock split are expected to be distributed by the Company’s transfer agent on or about Monday, September 10, 2007.

splits.label: four-for-one
splits.note: If approval is obtained, each NVIDIA stockholder of record at the close of business on June 21, 2021, will receive a dividend of three additional shares of common stock for every share held on the record date, to be distributed after the close of trading on July 19, 2021.

splits.label: ten-for-one
splits.note: Each record holder of common stock as of the close of market on Thursday, June 6, 2024, will receive nine additional shares of common stock, to be distributed after the close of market on Friday, June 7, 2024.

gross_margin.measure: gross margin change, bp (gross profit on revenue)

opex_gap.measure: research and development plus sales, general and administrative growth less revenue growth, pp (one statement)

inventory_gap.measure: year-end inventory growth less revenue growth, pp (one filing)

op_margin.measure: operating margin change, bp (income from operations on revenue, selected data)

fiscal_calendar.quote: We operate on a 52 or 53-week year, ending on the last Sunday in January.

price_basis: Yahoo's NVDA series is adjusted for every split (2000-06-27, 2001-09-12, 2006-04-07 and 2007-09-11, and the later 2021-07-20 and 2024-06-10); the builder multiplies it by the splits after AS_OF, so every price is on the AS_OF share basis: $30.00 on 2008-01-04, the close as traded.
